# Which forecast can you trust, and how much stock does it need?

> Free demand forecasting for small sellers. Upload a sales CSV to get a back-tested forecast per SKU, safety stock and reorder points at your service level, ABC-XYZ classes, and an honest check of whether the forecast beats repeating last month. With a cost per order and unit costs, it plans the cheapest order calendar per SKU (exact Wagner-Whitin lot sizing) and shows what Silver-Meal, a fixed EOQ and ordering every period would cost instead. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
